justification: Contribution is a planner/task-fetching-unit/executor that compiles function calls into a parallel execution DAG fixing step order; benchmarked in the lab on function-calling tasks vs ReAct, not deployed.

Novelty is the symbolic failure-detection judgement (ontology plus logical rules detect all failures online) that triggers recovery; empirically evaluated in the AI2Thor simulated kitchen against an LLM-only baseline.

Mechanism is what the loop does next: a value system proposes candidate activities and selects the next task each step; validated by lab experiments on the Concordia simulator against other LLM agents.
Contribution is procedural-memory placement and retrieval across orchestrator and task agents (what state carries across tasks); lab experiments on the OfficeBench benchmark, no real deployment.

The mechanism is a confirmation gate deciding whether the agent may proceed unaided, placed by a decision-theoretic model; validated in the lab by a formative study (8) and a within-subjects study (48 participants).
High-level planner performs goal decomposition and adaptive replanning that fixes the executor's next sub-task, with structured memory as support; lab validation on RMBench tasks plus ablations.

Contribution is a design space for how humans revise agent plans (semantic vs structural edits) determining the system's next steps; the AMBIPOM prototype is validated in a lab user study, not in practice.

Step verification trained on synthesized invalid samples acts as the process-level control signal admitting or rejecting each step; validated on math-reasoning and web-interaction tasks against prior training baselines.
Action Chains are proposed as the planning primitive, with proactive conflict validation and targeted refinement instead of full re-planning; validated on the TDW-MAT and C-WAH benchmarks in the lab.

Mechanism is a pre-execution gate: temporal logic and discrete event systems verify LLM task allocations before execution; only demonstrated on one multi-robot assembly scenario with no measured results.
Error Matrix Classification attributes failures to ten typed causes to guide subsequent correction and strategy revision; the abstract proposes the three components and reports no evaluation of them.

Contribution is a compilation layer turning skill sets into typed DAGs with precondition-effect edges that fix execution order, plus locality-bounded repair; lab benchmarks ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, InterCode.

Outer loop changes the agent between tasks: modular skills are identified from prior tasks and reflection on failures synthesizes new reusable solutions; validated on an existing and a new benchmark task in the lab.
Meta-Skill is refined across episodes by rollout plus selective reflection distilling past experience without parametric updates; validated in lab experiments over four benchmarks and four LLMs.

Empirical audit of one mechanism: an agentic LLM as the planning and execution-reasoning core of a cognitive architecture; studied in depth on two household tasks in a simulator, reporting emergent behaviour and limits.

Contribution decides the next step: value reasoning generates symbolic subgoals that a PDDL planner turns into action plans under closed-loop feedback; validated by TongSim experiments against baselines in simulation.

Deviation signals from the executor trigger reflection that rewrites subtask descriptions as corrective plans; validated on standard VLN benchmarks under a constrained data budget, runner-up planning_and_control_flow.

Argues forecasting should be organized as an agentic workflow of perception, planning, action, reflection and memory that determines each next step; a position paper with three outlined paradigms and no method or evaluation.

Proposals may update committed mission state only after deterministic verification and atomic commit, an explicit gate on agentic proposals; validated on a factory scenario, 30-seed stress benchmarks and ablations.
A Strategy Fitness Score triggers revision of the global plan when the agent is stuck, deciding the next step from holistic plan or local policy; validated on ALFWorld and Mind2Web with ablations.

Contribution is a persistent queryable external world model that fixes stateless drift, raising state-tracking accuracy 56 to 93 percent; validated in the lab on assembly, exploration and real-robot runs under induced failures.

Jailbreaking is formulated as risk-aware PDDL planning with a Planner deciding each turn's strategy, credited by the ablation to multi-step planning; validated against open and closed target models in the lab.

The mechanism judges runs: telemetry monitors plus deterministic verification that recomputes stated totals flag failing episodes before rollback; validated on 2823 lab episodes and two external corpora (AFTraj-2K, ATBench).

Outer RL loop trains the agent on its own failed trajectories via pivotal-turn credit assignment and reflection returns; validated on 4 agent tasks and 7 search QA benchmarks against MetaRL and GiGPO.

Contribution is a stepwise confidence estimate used to detect errors in multi-step reasoning, a judgement signal not a revision; lab comparison of holistic vs stepwise scoring on two benchmark datasets by AUC-ROC.
